name: LinkUp | Dating App
description: A full-stack dating ecosystem for college students. Featuring a high-performance FastAPI backend with real-time WebSockets and Redis caching for instant matching and messaging, paired with a cross-platform Flutter frontend utilizing BLoC for a seamless, responsive user experience.

name: HotDrop | P2P File Sharing
description: A cross-platform P2P file-sharing ecosystem. High-speed data transfer between Android and Windows using custom TCP protocols and internal binary stream servers. Features deep native integration for high-performance WiFi Direct and BLE-based peer discovery.
tech: Flutter, TCP Sockets, Kotlin, WiFi Direct, BLE

name: Cogni Anchor | Deloitte Capstone
description: An AI-powered dementia support ecosystem. Features a FastAPI backend with LangGraph for stateful AI reasoning, Whisper STT/TTS, and face recognition. The Flutter frontend provides a voice-first interface, smart reminders, and real-time geofencing safety alerts. Mentored by Deloitte.
